title: Watchlist features and quick actions
intro: The watchlist shows live price and change, holdings quantity and unrealised P&L, and offers Buy/Sell by swiping a row. Market depth, alerts and an order ticket open only on the full quote page, and rows have no mini chart. Both items are Product decisions first; the FE work reuses widgets that already exist in the quote module and stays behind a flag.

measured.current: 72.2 (DP2 sparkline No; DP3 depth Partial; DP7 alerts Partial; DP8 quick buy/sell Partial)
measured.expected: ≈ 88.9 if H1 is approved (DP3, DP7, DP8 to Yes); ≈ 100 with H2 as well (re-scored with the same checklist)

changes.title: Quick-action sheet over the watchlist
changes.summary: Add a bottom sheet over the list with Buy, Sell, 5-level market depth and Create Alert for a stock, opened from a row without leaving the watchlist. Long-press opens edit mode today, so the trigger is a Product choice. Behind a flag.
changes.risk_reason: New user-facing flow on the main list and a possible change to an existing gesture (long-press opens edit mode today). Needs live depth subscription and order-entry navigation. Behind WatchlistPerfFlags.quickActions, default off, with a full regression pass on the list.
changes.product_decision: Which gesture opens the quick-action sheet (tap on the price area, a new chevron, or long-press with edit mode moved to the menu)? Which actions does it show (Buy, Sell, 5-level market depth, Create Alert, View chart, Open quote page)?

files.change: When the flag is on, open WatchlistQuickActionsSheet from the chosen gesture; keep today's tap-to-quote and long-press-to-edit when it is off.

New sheet: header (name, LTP), Buy/Sell buttons (searchToPlaceOrderNavigation, as the swipe uses), depth rows via startBidStreaming/onDepthStreamReceived from BasePageState, Create Alert entry from mo_get_quote.

changes.current: The listing's InkWell long-press checks connectivity, logs a CleverTap event and calls switchToEditMode; a tap logs analytics and pushes the quote page with MoGetQuoteNavigator.navigateToScrip. Swiping a row calls searchToPlaceOrderNavigation with BUY or SELL (watchlist_listing.dart 420-456). Depth and alerts exist only on the quote page.
steps: Product picks the gesture and actions.
Build the sheet as a StreamingBaseWidget so depth subscription stops when it closes (stopBidStreaming).
Reuse searchToPlaceOrderNavigation for Buy/Sell and the quote module's alert entry point.
Log the same analytics events the quote page logs for these actions, with source 'watchlist_sheet'.
safety: Order placement goes through the existing order form, not a new path.
regression_checks: Flag off: long-press edit mode, tap to quote, swipe Buy/Sell as today.
Flag on: sheet opens, depth streams and stops on close, Buy/Sell open the order form with the right side, alert creation works.
Guest users get the guest sheet as with swipe.
changes.after_improvement: DP3, DP7 and DP8 can move from Partial to Yes; fewer full quote-page pushes (each push keeps the watchlist mounted underneath).

changes.title: Intraday sparkline on watchlist rows
changes.summary: Rows have no mini chart. A sparkline needs an intraday price series per symbol from BE (or a client-built series from ticks since open) and a Product decision on space in the row.
changes.risk_reason: New data source and new painting on every row; can undo the idle and scroll gains if not done carefully (one CustomPainter per row with shouldRepaint on data change only, RepaintBoundary). Behind a flag.
changes.product_decision: Should rows show an intraday sparkline? Where (between name and price), and for all lists or only stocks/indices?
changes.be_request: An API returning a compact intraday series (for example 5-minute closes since open) for up to 100 symbols in one call, cacheable for 5 minutes.

files.change: Add a fixed-size sparkline widget left of rightColumnLtp when the flag is on.

changes.current: rightColumnLtp shows LTP, an arrow SVG and change/% only. There is no price history on the watchlist.
steps: One CustomPainter per row with a fixed size and RepaintBoundary; repaint only when the series changes (not on every tick).
Fetch series once per open and every 5 min; append the last tick to the final point only if Product wants it live.
safety: Behind a flag (add a key to A1's holder), default off.
Painter repaints only on series change.
regression_checks: Scroll FPS (S5) and idle redraw (U4) re-measured with the flag on.
changes.after_improvement: DP2 moves from No to Yes.
